Returns settled (true once the check finished), possibly updated options and summary text, follow-up questions whose answers change the price or customs channel, and needs_review. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_offer_status, track_shipment · Private data: track_shipment · Public sink: check_offer_status, track_shipment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_offer_status, track_shipment · Private data: track_shipment · Public sink: check_offer_status, track_shipment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
